Participate in cloud-based workload automation transformation projects.

Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation best practices where applicable.

Support audit, compliance, and security requirements.
Ensure production scheduling changes follow approved change management processes.
Maintain operational documentation, procedures, and runbooks.

About the Role

The AI Technical Architect operates at the intersection of strategy and execution - acting as both a Strategist, shaping the long-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an Orchestrator, coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions. This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value.

Strategist Mindset

  • Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI-first design principles.

Position Overview

Vodafone Idea is looking for a seasoned AI Architect to design, build, and scale enterprise-grade AI and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for defining the technical architecture and roadmap for AI applications deployed on top of our enterprise Cloudera Data Platform (CDP 7.1.9 / 7.3.1).

You will bridge the gap between complex big data ecosystems and cutting-edge machine learning/LLM workflows. The ideal candidate brings hands-on expertise in model selection, lifecycle governance, prompt engineering, and production-grade MLOps/AIOps integrated into modern DevOps pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise AI & CDP Solution Architecture

  • Lead the end-to-end architecture and integration of Predictive AI and Generative AI applications built directly on CDP 7.1.9 / 7.3.1 infrastructure.
  • Design high-throughput, low-latency data pipelines and feature stores leveraging CDP components (Spark, Hive, Impala, Kafka, Apache Iceberg).
  • Establish retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, fine-tuning setups, and vector search systems connected to enterprise big data repositories.

2. Model Selection, Implementation & Governance

  • Evaluate, benchmark, and select optimal foundational models (LLMs, SLMs, open-source vs. proprietary) and classic ML algorithms tailored for telecom use cases (e.g., customer churn, network optimization, hyper-personalization, fraud detection).
  • Enforce robust AI Governance frameworks covering model drift detection, explainability (XAI), fairness/bias mitigation, data privacy, and compliance.
  • Manage model registry, lifecycle versioning, and policy enforcement across dynamic runtime environments.

  • Optimize token utilization, latency, throughput, and inference costs for LLM deployments.
  • Implement guardrails, output validation, and safety filters to prevent hallucination, data leakage, and security risks in public/private LLM interactions.

4. MLOps, AIOps & DevOps Integration

  • Design and implement robust MLOps/AIOps pipelines for automated model training, continuous integration, testing, deployment, and real-time monitoring (CI/CD/CT).
  • Partner with DevOps teams to deploy containerized AI microservices (Kubernetes, Docker) within hybrid-cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Configure comprehensive telemetry, logging, and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, MLflow, Weights & Biases) to maintain continuous operational health.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.

  • MLOps & Governance: Strong experience with MLflow, Model Registry, feature stores, model drift monitoring, data lineage, and enterprise AI guardrails.
  • DevOps Tools: Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), and Git workflows.
  • Programming Languages: Advanced expertise in Python, PySpark, SQL, and bash scripting.
  • Frameworks & Libraries: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vLLM, Triton Server.

jobDescription:
Description:

Main Responsibilities:
• Build end-to-end data pipelines including data collection, transformation, quality and integration solutions to facilitate Client data & analytics solutions.
• Collaborate with solution design and business requirements teams to identify data requirements and assemble large, complex data sets that meet the requirements
• Design, implement and fine-tune analytics solutions that meet business and technical requirements
• Work collaboratively with the Client data architect to ensure data model integrity
• Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources
• Create data tools for analytics and data scientist teams that assist them in building and optimising the data models and solutions
• Work with the DevOps engineer to support the consistent operation of data & analytics solutions
• Work closely with the data analysts & data scientists to design and develop APIs
• Weekly and need basis Status reporting to Client and Infosys managers
• Self-motivated, able to work independently, and attention to details
• Curious about emerging AI trends and their implications for data engineering
7 - 12 years

Academic Qualification:
• Bachelor or Masters degree in a related field (e.g. computer science, information technology, etc.)

Professional Experience
• Total experience of 7+ years in IT Industry in DWBI.
• Experience in Azure cloud platforms and technology
• Ability to define and develop data integration patterns and pipelines
• Strong knowledge of data modelling, data warehousing, and BI concepts
• Experience with Data Lake, Databricks, Data Factory, BI Dashboard, and BI implementation projects
• At least 4 years experience in SQL/PostgreSQL, data and BI solutions with integration to 3rd party tools
• Experience working with application server software (e.g. ERP), Spark, Scala, Python, SQL scripting languages, relational databases (e.g. SQL DB/DW), NoSQL platforms (e.g. HBase, MongoDB, Cassandra), cloud technologies (e.g. Azure)
• Highly experienced with processing large and complex datasets and building end-to-end data pipelines using on-premise or cloud-based data platforms
• Experienced in coding in data management, data warehousing or unstructured data environments
• Experience in the energy sector or other asset-intensive industries will be highly regarded
• Experience in using coding assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot) for uplifting productivity in development
• Familiar with GenAI concepts like RAG, orchestration frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex, vector databases etc. to collaborate efficiently with data scientists and ML engineers in AI use cases

Mandatory skills* Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Spark, Scala, Python, ADLS, Familiar with GenAI concepts

tagsAndSkills: Transcription,Bfsi,Consulting,Healthcare,SOW,Customer engagement,Stakeholder management,cisco
jobDescription:
AIVAR INNOVATIONS
Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery
3-5 Years | Coimbatore/ Bangalore |Full-Time
About Aivar Innovations
Aivar Innovations is an AI-native services and software company and an AWS Preferred Partner, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Sorin Investments. We ship production-grade AI into enterprise environments across fintech, healthcare, and technology. Our work is anchored by four accelerator platforms: Convogent (voice and agent AI automation), Velogent (governed agentic process automation for regulated industries), Kubogent (Kubernetes-native AIOps), and Datagent (data and analytics). We measure ourselves by what runs in production, not by slideware.
Role Overview
We are hiring a Senior Voice AI Engineer for Aivars Delivery organization to take voice AI use cases from discovery through live production for our enterprise customers. You will build and customize voice agents on top of Convogent - Aivars voice AI accelerator - working directly within customer engagements, delivery timelines, and SOW commitments. This is a hands-on engineering role embedded in customer-facing delivery pods, partnering closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and customer technical stakeholders to ship measurable outcomes on live calls.
What Youll Do
  • Own customer delivery outcomes. Take voice AI use cases from discovery through production go-live within committed timelines, working inside Rocketlane-tracked delivery plans alongside your Delivery Manager.
  • Customize and configure Convogent. Adapt Aivars voice AI accelerator (built on Pipecat, LiveKit) to each customers telephony stack (Twilio, Exotel, Cisco, Vonage, etc.), API/MCP integrations with customer CRM tools, knowledge base (KB) integrations, compliance constraints, and use-case requirements.
  • Engineer real-time audio pipelines for production. Optimize STT and TTS flows for the latency, concurrency, and call quality bar each customer engagement demands.
  • Troubleshoot customer production systems. When a live call does not sound right, quickly narrow down where in the pipeline it broke - capture, STT, orchestration, or TTS - by asking the right questions, reading the right signals, and driving the fix through to resolution.
  • Build and adapt the orchestration layer. Connect STT, TTS, and LLM agents into resilient, observable workflows with guardrails suited to the customers risk and compliance profile.
  • Translate customer requirements into deployable solutions. Work directly with customer technical stakeholders alongside Aivars SA and DM to scope, size, and iterate use cases against measurable outcomes - success rate, latency, adoption.
  • Report and govern delivery. Contribute to sprint tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder governance for the use cases you own.
What Youll Bring
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying voice agents with Pipecat, LiveKit, or similar frameworks - ideally across multiple distinct production deployments, not a single system.
  • Deep expertise in STT (Deepgram, Whisper, AssemblyAI, Google STT, Sarvam) and TTS (ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Amazon Polly).
  • Working knowledge of Speech-to-Speech (S2S) services, including Amazon Nova Sonic, and how they change pipeline and orchestration design compared to cascaded STT/LLM/TTS.
  • Experience with multi-speaker diarization and conversation segmentation.
  • Production fluency in Python plus at least one of Node.js, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Practical use of AI/ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) and conversational AI design - prompt engineering and integration with LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Bedrock models).
  • Cloud deployment experience on AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, EKS, Polly, Transcribe, Bedrock) with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under SOW/contract constraints - scoping, prioritizing, and shipping within a defined timeline and budget across live customer engagements.
  • Comfort working across multiple concurrent customer engagements with differing requirements, tech stacks, and stakeholders.
Preferred Experience
  • Prior experience in a customer delivery, consulting, or systems integration role, rather than purely product/platform engineering.
  • Exposure to regulated industries (fintech, healthcare, BFSI) and their compliance and security constraints.
  • Experience with enterprise stakeholder management - running status calls, translating technical tradeoffs into business language.
  • Familiarity with low-code voice platforms alongside custom infrastructure.
  • Voice analytics, transcription tooling, and Indian-language STT/TTS models.
  • AWS or speech technology certifications.

Why This Role, Why Aivar

  • Work that ships to real customers. Every use case you build runs live on enterprise calls, measured by customer outcomes, not demos.
  • Own delivery end-to-end. From discovery call to production go-live, you are the engineering owner of the customers voice AI outcome.
  • Build on accelerators that work. Convogent has real production traction - you configure and extend a working platform across diverse customer environments.
  • Direct customer exposure. Work face-to-face with enterprise technical stakeholders, not just internal teams.
  • Backed and proven. AI-native, AWS Preferred Partner, BVP- and Sorin-backed, with 100+ enterprise customers in the first year.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Kuku TV is looking for a Mid-Senior Video Editor (2-5 years) who can turn scripts, performances, live-action footage, and AI-generated visuals into high-retention, binge-worthy micro-dramas. This role is ideal for an editor who understands that great short-form storytelling is not just about cutting footage-it s about hooking viewers, building emotion, escalating conflict, and ending every episode with a reason to watch the next one.

You ll work across live-action + AI-generated content in a fast-paced, high-volume episodic production environment.

Responsibilities

Storytelling Editing

  • Edit live-action and AI-generated micro-dramas for mobile-first audiences.
  • Create powerful opening hooks, emotional peaks, reveals, twists, payoffs, and cliffhangers.
  • Shape dialogue, performances, music, SFX, voiceovers, and visuals into compelling narratives.
  • Select the strongest takes to maximise emotion, conflict, suspense, and character relationships.
  • Maintain strong pacing, visual rhythm, dialogue clarity, narrative progression, and audience retention.
  • Apply principles of information control, escalating conflict, pattern interruption, and retention-driven editing.

Mobile-First Storytelling

  • Edit specifically for vertical 9:16 formats and mobile viewing.
  • Maintain strong composition, visual hierarchy, readable performances, and screen impact.
  • Understand how to optimise storytelling for short attention spans and binge consumption.

AI Video VFX

  • Work confidently with AI-generated characters, environments, performances, and shots.
  • Identify and fix AI-video issues such as facial inconsistencies, lip-sync errors, flickering, warping, unnatural movement, frame instability, and continuity issues.
  • Handle AI-assisted post-production including lip-sync correction, cleanup, upscaling, frame interpolation, shot extension, masking, tracking, compositing, and background replacement.
  • Know when an AI shot can be fixed in post-production and when it needs to be regenerated.

Visual Sound Finishing

  • Seamlessly integrate live-action and AI footage through colour correction, grading, reframing, compositing, motion treatment, and visual matching.
  • Create titles, captions, transitions, motion graphics, VFX, recaps, end cards, and promotional elements when required.
  • Handle dialogue editing, music, ambience, Foley, and SFX to strengthen emotional and dramatic impact.
  • Ensure clear audio balance across mobile devices and viewing environments.

Production Collaboration

  • Maintain story, character, costume, location, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and performance continuity.
  • Manage multiple episodes, revisions, and priorities in a fast-moving production pipeline.
  • Collaborate with directors, writers, creative producers, AI artists, and sound designers.
  • Implement feedback accurately and meet tight delivery timelines.
  • Maintain organised project files, proxies, media libraries, naming conventions, version histories, templates, and archival masters.
  • Perform creative and technical QC and deliver final episodes to required platform, codec, resolution, frame-rate, aspect-ratio, and audio specifications.

What we re looking for

Must Have

  • 2-7 years of professional video-editing experience, preferably in fiction, micro-dramas, web series, films, TV, advertising, digital entertainment, or narrative short-form content.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, dramatic pacing, emotional editing, and technical polish.
  • Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro skills.
  • Advanced Adobe after Effects skills, including compositing, masking, and tracking, cleanup, and motion graphics.
  • Strong knowledge of Gen AI tool - Runaway, ElevanLabs, Kling, Veo, Adobe Firefly, Topaz or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve for colour correction, grading, finishing, and media management.

jobDescription:

Type- Full-time

About the company and the product
India Health Link is building a new multi-tenant Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) - one platform serving many hospitals - with Artificial Intelligence (AI) features delivered as optional plug-ins on top of a core that works fully without them. It is a greenfield build, and the first pilot hospital goes live in month 6.

Our stack : Amazon Web Services (AWS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker, TypeScript and NestJS services, PostgreSQL 16, Python for the AI services.

What you will build
- The whole AWS footprint as Terraform code : Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Container Service (ECS) Fargate, Relational Database Service (RDS) PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Simple Storage Service (S3), OpenSearch, Redis, EventBridge and CloudFront.
- Continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) on GitHub Actions: build, test, migrate, deploy, roll back. Deployment must be boring.
- Environments : development, staging, pre-production with anonymised data, and production.
- Monitoring and alerting that a twelve-person team can actually respond to, with centralised logs and traces.
- Backup and disaster recovery with a tested restore, not a documented one.
- The on-premise edge gateway image that runs inside a hospitals local network for analyser connectivity and Local Area Network mode when the internet is down.

Responsibilities
- Own infrastructure cost, keep it inside the agreed monthly budget, and report it monthly.
- Own security hygiene: least-privilege identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, patching, and network boundaries.
- Own remediation for the Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Test (VAPT) in month 5 - coordinate the external firm and drive every finding to closure.
- Make the developer experience good. A new engineer should be productive on day two.
- Set up data-residency arrangements appropriate to Indian health data.
- Be the person who can tell, at 2 am, whether the problem is our service, the database, or the hospitals internet connection.

Requirements
- Four or more years on AWS in production, including ECS or equivalent container orchestration, RDS, IAM and VPC networking.
- Terraform written and maintained by you, with proper modules and state management.
- Ownership of a CI/CD pipeline, including the database migration step.
- Observability in practice: you have been on call, and you have tuned alerts that were too noisy.
- Linux and networking fundamentals - you can debug why a device inside a hospital cannot reach a service.

Good to have
- Compliance work: ISO 27001, SOC 2, or Indian health data regulation.
- On-premise or hybrid deployments, and hardware appliances in the field.
- Real cost optimisation on a live bill.
- Experience supporting customers with unreliable connectivity.

Your first 90 days
- Month 1 - all environments live, CI/CD running, the walking skeleton deployed automatically.
- Month 2 - monitoring, alerting and centralised logs in place; backups running with a tested restore.
- Month 3 - the edge gateway image built and running against analyser simulators.

How we work
Two-week sprints. Everything is code - infrastructure included. Code review on every pull request.

jobDescription:
Senior Data Engineer

Data & Analytics

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer to shape and strengthen the data foundation that drives company performance.

This is a senior individual contributor role with meaningful influence. You will define engineering standards, evolve our data platform, and ensure data is reliably integrated and structured to support confident decision making across the organization.

Success in this role requires more than technical execution. You will be expected to operate independently, bring structure to ambiguity, challenge unclear assumptions, and translate complex system and business problems into durable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Platform Leadership

  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of data pipelines and integration frameworks
  • Define standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data movement across the platform
  • Improve reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of data pipelines and storage
  • Design scalable, reusable patterns that support consistent data flow across systems

Data Integration and Architecture

  • Design and implement integrations across internal and external systems using tools such as Fivetran and custom pipelines
  • Own how data enters and moves through the warehouse, ensuring consistency and integrity
  • Structure data layers to support both upstream flexibility and downstream consumption
  • Ensure strong alignment between source system logic and warehouse representations

Data Modeling and Foundation

  • Architect and implement core data models in Snowflake using dbt
  • Build durable data layers aligned to core revenue and operational domains
  • Ensure strong alignment between upstream data structures and downstream reporting needs
  • Embed testing, documentation, and performance optimization into standard engineering practice

Data Reliability and Quality

  • Establish and enforce data quality standards across ingestion and transformation layers
  • Design systems for validation, monitoring, and lineage
  • Proactively identify and resolve data issues, reducing ambiguity and downstream impact
  • Strengthen trust in enterprise data through consistent and reliable delivery

AI-Enabled Data Systems

  • Treat AI as a core capability in modern data engineering, leveraging it to deliver high-quality solutions with greater speed and rigor
  • Design data pipelines and structures that enable safe and effective use of AI with trusted data
  • Integrate AI into engineering workflows to accelerate development, monitoring, and optimization
  • Apply disciplined judgment when evaluating AI-generated outputs, ensuring enterprise standards for accuracy and consistency
  • Establish practical guardrails for responsible AI usage across both engineering and business consumption

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Translate complex and ambiguous business questions into scalable data solutions
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and business stakeholders
  • Introduce platform and process improvements and drive them through implementation
  • Influence data standards across the Data & Analytics function

What We Look For

  • Ability to operate independently in complex, evolving environments
  • Clear and structured communication
  • Strong analytical reasoning and systems thinking
  • Ownership mindset with focus on measurable business outcomes
  • Willingness to challenge assumptions constructively
  • High standards for data quality, reliability, and engineering rigor

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics engineering
  • Strong experience with data integration, pipeline development, and warehouse architecture
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake and dbt
  • Experience with data integration tools such as Fivetran
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS
  • Advanced SQL with demonstrated performance tuning expertise
  • Experience with Git-based workflows and GitHub for version control
  • Experience building and operating reliable data pipelines

Preferred:

  • Experience in SaaS or subscription-based businesses
  • Experience working with global stakeholders
  • Python for automation or platform tooling

Impact

The systems and standards established in this role will directly influence data reliability, operational efficiency, and decision making. The quality of this foundation will determine how effectively the organization leverages both trusted data and AI to drive performance.


How We Think About AI
At Quickbase, we view AI as a tool to accelerate how work gets done not replace it. We encourage thoughtful use of AI to improve speed, quality, and decision-making, while maintaining strong judgment, accountability, and data integrity.

Summary
Build AI native, HANA optimized SAP applications and extensions by combining deep ABAP on HANA engineering with agentic AI patterns (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). The role focuses on delivering high performance, cloud ready, production-grade solutions using HANA pushdown principles, modern ABAP, and governed AI capabilities that can reason, retrieve context, and assist or act within enterprise SAP workflowswithout training foundation models from scratch.

Core Responsibilities
1) ABAP on HANA Engineering (Performance First)
Design and develop ABAP solutions optimized for SAP HANA using pushdown principles (minimize data movement, maximize in database processing).
Build efficient data models and access patterns using CDS views, associations, annotations, and authorization concepts.
Implement performance critical logic using AMDP / SQLScript where appropriate, with careful governance and testing.
2) Modern ABAP Development Clean Design
Develop modular, testable, and maintainable ABAP code aligned to clean architecture practices and enterprise SDLC.
Build services and APIs using modern paradigms (OData/service exposure patterns), ensuring stability, versioning, and contract-first behavior.
Apply secure coding standards and authorization checks consistently across data and service layers.
3) Data Modeling, Reporting Semantic Enablement
Model enterprise business entities using CDS semantics to support both transactional and analytical consumption.
Design reusable data artifacts that support downstream consumers (UI, integrations, analytics, and AI retrieval layers).
Ensure lineage-friendly structures and consistent business definitions to reduce ambiguity across systems.
4) AI Native SAP Capabilities (Agentic + Grounded)
Build AI enabled SAP experiences that integrate ABAP services with LLM capabilities, including:
oTool calling orchestration (LLM triggers approved SAP actions via controlled APIs)
oRetrieval grounded outputs (RAG style grounding) over governed SAP data and documentation
oDeterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak or confidence is low
Implement prompts/templates, tool schemas, and context assembly strategies that reduce hallucinations and enforce enterprise safety boundaries.
5) Quality Engineering Evaluation Loops (AI + ABAP)
Build automated tests (unit/integration/contract) for ABAP services and data artifacts enforce regression coverage for performance and correctness.
Establish evaluation harnesses for AI behaviors:offline golden datasets, scenario-based tests, and online monitoring to detect drift/regressions.
Introduce guardrails for AI outputs:authorization-aware context filtering, redaction rules, action confirmations, and audit logs.
6) Observability, Reliability Operations
Instrument services and critical logic with logs/metrics/traces suitable for production support and root-cause analysis.
Design robust error handling for enterprise flows:retries, idempotency, correlation IDs, and safe failure modes.
Support incident response with runbooks and structured diagnostics continuously harden solutions based on observed failure patterns.
7) Integration End to End Delivery
Integrate ABAP on HANA services with SAP and non SAP ecosystems (event-driven patterns, API gateways, enterprise integration layers).
Collaborate with UX, integration, data, and platform teams to ensure end to end solution correctness and performance.
Prototype rapidly, demonstrate frequently, and evolve prototypes into scalable production systems with security and compliance baked in.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
Strong hands on expertise in ABAP Development on HANA (performance tuning, pushdown, efficient SQL access patterns).
Proficiency with CDS views and modern data modeling practices (associations, annotations, authorization concepts).
Experience with AMDP / SQLScript for performance critical scenarios and controlled code pushdown.
Solid software engineering discipline:clean design, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation, and production readiness.
AI native build capability:LLM integration, retrieval grounding, tool orchestration, evaluation loops, and safety boundaries.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
OData/service design patterns, API lifecycle management, and contract-first development.
Experience integrating SAP backends with cloud runtimes and enterprise integration platforms.
Familiarity with performance benchmarking, load testing, and query-plan driven tuning practices.
Knowledge of SAP security/authorizations and compliance requirements for sensitive enterprise data.

What This Role Does Not Center On
Training or fine tuning foundation models from scratch.
AI assisted only development this role builds and owns AI behaviors (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability) as part of SAP solution delivery.

Value Delivered
High performance SAP solutions through HANA optimized ABAP engineering and disciplined pushdown design.
Faster delivery of intelligent SAP workflows via agentic AI patterns that are grounded, governed, and measurable.
Reduced operational risk through automated testing, observability, and robust safety boundaries for AI-enabled actions.

A 15 years full time education is required

Summary
You will design, configure, and enhance SAP Production Planning (PP) processes for discrete manufacturing environments while using AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution. The role focuses on delivering efficient production planning, shop floor execution, and material staging processes while integrating pre built AI services where beneficial. No deep AI model engineering, vector DB work, RAG, or agentic system development is required.


Key Responsibilities
Functional Technical Delivery
Configure and support SAP PP processes including:
oMaterial Requirement Planning (MRP)
oProduction Orders Execution
oRoutings, Work Centers BOM Management
oCapacity Planning Scheduling
oBackflushing Costing Integration
oGoods Movements Shop floor Reporting
Use AI copilots to accelerate:
oFunctional specification creation
oRouting/BOM validation
oTest case generation for MRP, order creation, confirmations
oDocumentation automation (FS/TS/SOPs)
Support full lifecycle delivery:requirements, design, configuration, SIT/UAT, deployment, hypercare support.
Integrate PP with MM, QM, SD, FI/CO, and shop floor systems (MES), leveraging standard APIs and middleware.
AI Assisted Productivity
Use AI copilots for:
oAutomated summarization of requirements and change impacts
oAnalysis of MRP exceptions and planning alerts
oValidation of order execution and production variances
oFaster defect isolation in BOM/routing/work center configurations
Integrate pre built AI services into production workflows, such as:
oPredictive insights (e.g., potential material shortages or order delays)
oIntelligent classification of production issues
oAutomated summarization of production batch deviations
oSmart suggestions based on historical production performance
Use LLM assisted troubleshooting to reduce time spent analyzing MRP exception messages, order failures, and material shortages.
Governance, Quality Collaboration
Ensure compliance with production governance, change controls, data accuracy standards, and audit policies.
Participate in workshops, solution reviews, and process optimization discussions enhanced by AI generated insights.
Collaborate with production, quality, warehouse, procurement, cost controlling, and integration teams to deliver end to end planning excellence.
Create reusable templates, checklists, test packs, and AI enabled best practices for SAP PP delivery.

Required Skills Experience
SAP PP Expertise
Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes including BOM/routing management, production order cycles, capacity planning, scheduling, and MRP.
Experience with integration across MM (material availability), QM (inspection lots), SD (demand), and FI/CO (costing).
Familiarity with order confirmations, settlements, and shop floor data capture processes.
AI Ready Skills
Ability to use AI copilots, automated documentation tools, and AI assisted test accelerators.
Comfortable embedding pre built AI capabilities into production planning or execution (not custom model building).
Awareness of responsible AI usage and limitations in manufacturing and planning environments.
General Professional Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to production variability, MRP outcomes, and resource planning.
Ability to translate manufacturing requirements into scalable SAP PP configurations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and operational teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

Good to Have
SAP PP Certification (S/4HANA Manufacturing).
Experience with MES systems, shop floor integrations, or IoT enabled production data.
Exposure to EWM/WM, PM, or APO/IBP environments.
Familiarity with automated testing tools (Tricentis, CBTA).

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more reliable SAP PP solutions using AI enabled productivity tools.
Improve planning accuracy, resource utilization, and production stability.
Act as a bridge between manufacturing teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native experts when deeper AI capabilities are required.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education

As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. What you would do in this role

A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

jobDescription:
About The Role

Project Role :Custom Software Engineer


Project Role Description :Design, build and configure applications to meet business process and application requirements.
Must have skills :SAP ABAP Cloud

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum

5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
Build AI native, cloud ready SAP solutions on ABAP Cloud by combining deep ABAP and SAP platform expertise with agentic AI architectures, LLM tooling, and rapid experimentation. The role focuses on designing, implementing, and scaling intelligent SAP applications that integrate ABAP Cloud with LLMs, retrieval pipelines, APIs, and enterprise systemsmoving from automation to autonomy.
This role actively builds AI systems, not just consumes AI tools.

Core Responsibilities
AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.
Implement AI enabled SAP extensions using RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), event driven patterns, and cloud native architectures.
Develop clean, testable ABAP code that integrates seamlessly with AI services and enterprise APIs.
Agentic LLM Integration
Implement agentic workflows:tools, planners, memory, orchestration, and evaluation loops integrated with SAP processes.
Integrate LLMs, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines (RAG) with ABAP Cloud services for contextual, grounded responses.
Design prompt templates, grounding strategies, fallback logic, and safety boundaries suitable for enterprise SAP use cases.
Data, Retrieval Context
Build and integrate retrieval pipelines using SAP and non SAP data sources (business objects, CDS views, documents, events).
Implement chunking, indexing, embeddings, and context assembly to support production grade RAG scenarios.
Ensure factuality, traceability, and explainability in AI driven SAP workflows.
Quality, Safety Reliability
Implement evaluation frameworks (offline and online) for AI behaviors integrated with SAP processes.
Design guardrails for authorization, data privacy, action boundaries, and error handling.
Build observability into AI enabled SAP applications (telemetry, logging, failure analysis).
Rapid Experimentation Scale Out
Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate based on business feedback.
Move AI prototypes into enterprise grade SAP production systems with performance, security, and compliance in mind.
Continuously refine AI behavior, prompts, and orchestration strategies.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP ABAP Cloud (RAP, CDS, OData, clean core principles).
Hands on experience integrating LLMs and AI services into applications.
Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, and contextual retrieval.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (design, testing, CI/CD).
Ability to translate business problems into AI enabled SAP solutions.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Experience with SAP BTP, eventing, APIs, and cloud services.
Familiarity with agent frameworks or custom orchestration logic.
Exposure to vector databases, search, or semantic indexing (SAP native or external).
Knowledge of enterprise security, authorization, and compliance patterns.


Value Delivered
Intelligent SAP applications that reason, retrieve, and act, not just automate.
Faster innovation cycles by embedding AI directly into SAP business logic.
Scalable, secure AI powered SAP extensions aligned with clean core principles.
Foundation for autonomous, AI driven enterprise workflows.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education

Summary
Build AI native, data centric products on SAP BTP Datasphere by combining strong enterprise data warehousing and semantic modeling expertise with agentic AI architectures (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). The focus is to move beyond dashboards into intelligent data experiencesdata agents, conversational analytics, and grounded insightsbuilt on governed Datasphere models and integrated enterprise sources.
SAP Datasphere is positioned as a data warehousing solution with integration capabilities.
Core Responsibilities
1) AI Native Data Product Engineering (on Datasphere)
Design and implement governed data products using Datasphere concepts such as Spaces and shareable models/views, enabling teams to explore, transform, and share curated datasets across domains.
Build semantic models that are fit for both analytics and AI consumption (clear entity definitions, measures, hierarchies, lineage-friendly design).
2) Retrieval + Grounding (RAG) over Enterprise Data
Create grounded AI experiences by connecting LLM applications to Datasphere s curated models and enterprise sources (SAP and non SAP), ensuring responses are traceable to governed data.
Engineer retrieval strategies that respect domain boundaries (spaces), freshness needs, and access controls, so AI outputs remain reliable and compliant.
3) Hybrid Modernization Migration (BW bridge patterns)
Enable transition paths from legacy warehouse investments by leveraging approaches such as reusing SAP BW models and skills with Datasphere / BW bridge, supporting phased cloud modernization.
4) Lakehouse style Layering Data Quality by Design
Implement layered design patterns (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold) to land raw data, cleanse/validate, and publish analytics ready modelswhile maintaining clear rules for what s exposed for consumption.
Embed quality controls, validation checks, and reproducible transformations as part of the delivery lifecycle.
5) Agentic Orchestration Tooling
Build data agents that can plan, call tools (query/metadata/lineage), retrieve context, and generate answers with citationsbacked by deterministic checks and fallback behaviors.
Implement prompt templates, tool schemas, and safe action boundaries for enterprise-grade usage.
6) Evaluation, Observability Responsible AI
Establish offline/online evaluation loops (golden questions, regression suites, behavior tests) for conversational analytics and data agents.
Add telemetry for AI interactions (latency, grounding rate, failure modes) to improve reliability and cost efficiency.
7) Integration Collaboration
Partner closely with business, data governance, and platform teams to align data products with real decisions and operational workflows.
Drive reusable patterns and accelerators for repeatable delivery across domains.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP BTP Datasphere:data modeling, spaces, sharing patterns, enterprise semantic design.
Strong data warehousing fundamentals and ability to translate business domains into governed analytical models.
Hands-on building with LLMs + RAG (retrieval, grounding, prompt/tool design, evaluation).
Solid software engineering fundamentals:testability, CI/CD mindset, reliable integrations.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Migration/modernization experience leveraging BW bridge style transition patterns.
Layered architecture implementation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) for scalable analytics delivery.
Familiarity with vector search / embedding pipelines (when integrating external AI retrieval components).

What This Role Does Not Center On
Training foundation models from scratch (the emphasis is on building agentic apps and governed retrieval on enterprise data).
AI assisted only delivery this role owns the AI behavior (grounding, evaluation, safety) end to end.

Value Delivered
Faster path from data to decision through conversational + agentic analytics grounded in governed Datasphere models.
Scalable modernization of hybrid data estates via patterns like BW bridge.
Higher trust AI outputs by implementing layered quality + evaluation loops.

title: AI Video Artist & VFX Specialist
tagsAndSkills: AI Video Generation,python,github,gaming,premiere pro,color grading,gaming industry,generative ai
jobDescription:
About the Role

  • We are looking for a visionary AI Video Artist who is not just a prompter, but a true technical creator.
  • You sit at the intersection of Visual Effects (VFX), Game Engines, and Generative AI.
  • You will be responsible for creating hyper-realistic, cinematic video content by blending traditional compositing tools with state-of-the-art AI platforms.
  • We don't just want "AI videos"we want production-grade realism.
  • You must understand lighting, camera movement, and consistency, using AI as a power tool to accelerate high-end workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Creation: Conceptualize and produce high-fidelity video content using a hybrid workflow of AI generation and manual VFX polishing.
  • Advanced AI Prompting: Utilize tools like Runway (Gen-3), Kling, Midjourney, and Sora/Veo to generate base assets with precise camera control and character consistency.
  • VFX & Compositing: Take AI-generated raw footage and refine it using After Effects, Nuke, or DaVinci Resolve.
  • Fix artifacts, handle color grading, and ensure temporal stability (no "flickering").
  • 3D & Gaming Integration: Work with Unreal Engine 5 or Blender to create realistic environments and integrate digital avatars if required.
  • Character Consistency: Train or fine-tune models (LoRAs/ControlNet) to ensure characters look exactly the same across different shots and angles.
  • R&D: Stay updated daily on the newest AI tools.
  • If a new model drops on Hugging Face or GitHub, you should be the first to test it.

Required Skills & Toolset 1.

  • The "Real" Tech Stack (Non-Negotiable): VFX/Editing: Mastery of Adobe After Effects (Compositing, Roto), Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve (Color Grading).
  • 3D Basics: Familiarity with Blender or Unreal Engine (Camera setting, Lighting, Environment design).
  • The AI Stack (Deep Knowledge Required): Video Gen: Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Kling AI, Luma Dream Machine, or Haiper.
  • Image Gen: Midjourney v6 (Advanced Parameters), Stable Diffusion (ComfyUI workflows are a huge plus).
  • Lip-Sync & Voice: ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or LivePortrait.
  • Optimization: Topaz Video AI (Upscaling) and interpolation tools.
  • Soft Skills: "Director's Eye": You understand cinematographyfocal lengths, shutter angles, lighting setups (Rim light, Key light), and composition.
  • Problem Solving: AI makes mistakes.
  • You must know how to fix "weird hands" or "glitchy eyes" manually in post-production.

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points)

  • Experience in the Gaming Industry (Level Design, Cinematics, or Character Rigging).
  • Knowledge of ComfyUI Node systems for complex Stable Diffusion workflows.
  • Experience with Python scripting for automating media workflows.
  • Background in traditional art or photography.
  • Who You Are You don't just type "Make a cool video" into ChatGPT.
  • You write detailed prompts like "Cinematic wide shot, 35mm lens, volumetric lighting, cyberpunk street, unreal engine 5 render style --ar 16:9".
  • You are frustrated when AI video looks "wobbly" and you know exactly how to stabilize it.
  • You have an open mindset: You are willing to relearn your workflow every month as technology changes.
  • Submission Requirement Please do not send just a CV.
  • You must share a Portfolio or Showreel demonstrating: AI-Generated Video work (mentioning the tools used).
  • Any VFX breakdowns (Before/After) showing how you fixed/improved raw AI output.

oValidation of order execution and production variances

Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

Summary
You will design, configure, and enhance SAP Production Planning (PP) processes for discrete manufacturing environments while using AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution. The role focuses on delivering efficient production planning, shop floor execution, and material staging processes while integrating pre built AI services where beneficial. No deep AI model engineering, vector DB work, RAG, or agentic system development is required.


Key Responsibilities
Functional Technical Delivery
Configure and support SAP PP processes including:
oMaterial Requirement Planning (MRP)
oProduction Orders Execution
oRoutings, Work Centers BOM Management
oCapacity Planning Scheduling
oBackflushing Costing Integration
oGoods Movements Shop floor Reporting
Use AI copilots to accelerate:
oFunctional specification creation
oRouting/BOM validation
oTest case generation for MRP, order creation, confirmations
oDocumentation automation (FS/TS/SOPs)
Support full lifecycle delivery:requirements, design, configuration, SIT/UAT, deployment, hypercare support.
Integrate PP with MM, QM, SD, FI/CO, and shop floor systems (MES), leveraging standard APIs and middleware.
AI Assisted Productivity
Use AI copilots for:
oAutomated summarization of requirements and change impacts
oAnalysis of MRP exceptions and planning alerts
oValidation of order execution and production variances
oFaster defect isolation in BOM/routing/work center configurations
Integrate pre built AI services into production workflows, such as:
oPredictive insights (e.g., potential material shortages or order delays)
oIntelligent classification of production issues
oAutomated summarization of production batch deviations
oSmart suggestions based on historical production performance
Use LLM assisted troubleshooting to reduce time spent analyzing MRP exception messages, order failures, and material shortages.
Governance, Quality Collaboration
Ensure compliance with production governance, change controls, data accuracy standards, and audit policies.
Participate in workshops, solution reviews, and process optimization discussions enhanced by AI generated insights.
Collaborate with production, quality, warehouse, procurement, cost controlling, and integration teams to deliver end to end planning excellence.
Create reusable templates, checklists, test packs, and AI enabled best practices for SAP PP delivery.

Required Skills Experience
SAP PP Expertise
Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes including BOM/routing management, production order cycles, capacity planning, scheduling, and MRP.
Experience with integration across MM (material availability), QM (inspection lots), SD (demand), and FI/CO (costing).
Familiarity with order confirmations, settlements, and shop floor data capture processes.
AI Ready Skills
Ability to use AI copilots, automated documentation tools, and AI assisted test accelerators.
Comfortable embedding pre built AI capabilities into production planning or execution (not custom model building).
Awareness of responsible AI usage and limitations in manufacturing and planning environments.
General Professional Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to production variability, MRP outcomes, and resource planning.
Ability to translate manufacturing requirements into scalable SAP PP configurations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and operational teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

Good to Have
SAP PP Certification (S/4HANA Manufacturing).
Experience with MES systems, shop floor integrations, or IoT enabled production data.
Exposure to EWM/WM, PM, or APO/IBP environments.
Familiarity with automated testing tools (Tricentis, CBTA).

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more reliable SAP PP solutions using AI enabled productivity tools.
Improve planning accuracy, resource utilization, and production stability.
Act as a bridge between manufacturing teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native experts when deeper AI capabilities are required.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.

Practice:- Marketing Analytics

Title:- Consultant/ Manager/Analyst Marketing Customer Data Platforms (GCP, CDP, Agentic AI)

About SC - Global Network (GN) :- Accenture GNs Data AI (AI Hub India) practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling to outperform the competition.

WHATS IN IT FOR YOU

As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.

What you would do in this role

A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.

  • Architect Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

SAP Datasphere is positioned as a data warehousing solution with integration capabilities.
Core Responsibilities
1) AI Native Data Product Engineering (on Datasphere)
Design and implement governed data products using Datasphere concepts such as Spaces and shareable models/views, enabling teams to explore, transform, and share curated datasets across domains.
Build semantic models that are fit for both analytics and AI consumption (clear entity definitions, measures, hierarchies, lineage-friendly design).
2) Retrieval + Grounding (RAG) over Enterprise Data
Create grounded AI experiences by connecting LLM applications to Datasphere s curated models and enterprise sources (SAP and non SAP), ensuring responses are traceable to governed data.
Engineer retrieval strategies that respect domain boundaries (spaces), freshness needs, and access controls, so AI outputs remain reliable and compliant.
3) Hybrid Modernization Migration (BW bridge patterns)
Enable transition paths from legacy warehouse investments by leveraging approaches such as reusing SAP BW models and skills with Datasphere / BW bridge, supporting phased cloud modernization.
4) Lakehouse style Layering Data Quality by Design
Implement layered design patterns (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold) to land raw data, cleanse/validate, and publish analytics ready modelswhile maintaining clear rules for what s exposed for consumption.
Embed quality controls, validation checks, and reproducible transformations as part of the delivery lifecycle.
5) Agentic Orchestration Tooling
Build data agents that can plan, call tools (query/metadata/lineage), retrieve context, and generate answers with citationsbacked by deterministic checks and fallback behaviors.
Implement prompt templates, tool schemas, and safe action boundaries for enterprise-grade usage.
6) Evaluation, Observability Responsible AI
Establish offline/online evaluation loops (golden questions, regression suites, behavior tests) for conversational analytics and data agents.
Add telemetry for AI interactions (latency, grounding rate, failure modes) to improve reliability and cost efficiency.
7) Integration Collaboration
Partner closely with business, data governance, and platform teams to align data products with real decisions and operational workflows.
Drive reusable patterns and accelerators for repeatable delivery across domains.

SAP BTP Datasphere:data modeling, spaces, sharing patterns, enterprise semantic design.

Hands-on building with LLMs + RAG (retrieval, grounding, prompt/tool design, evaluation).
Solid software engineering fundamentals:testability, CI/CD mindset, reliable integrations.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Migration/modernization experience leveraging BW bridge style transition patterns.
Layered architecture implementation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) for scalable analytics delivery.
Familiarity with vector search / embedding pipelines (when integrating external AI retrieval components).

Training foundation models from scratch (the emphasis is on building agentic apps and governed retrieval on enterprise data).
AI assisted only delivery this role owns the AI behavior (grounding, evaluation, safety) end to end.

Faster path from data to decision through conversational + agentic analytics grounded in governed Datasphere models.

Higher trust AI outputs by implementing layered quality + evaluation loops.

Functional Technical Delivery

Integrate TRM with FI, CO, In House Cash, Bank Communication Management, Market Data providers, and external financial platforms.
AI Assisted Productivity
Apply AI copilots for:
oTreasury process analysis
oExposure/position interpretation
oTesting acceleration
oDocumentation generation

Use LLM assisted troubleshooting tools to accelerate root cause analysis and data verification.

Conduct workshops, walkthroughs, and risk impact analyses using AI augmented insights.
Contribute to reusable templates, decision trees, configuration patterns, and AI enhanced best practices.

Required Skills Experience
SAP Treasury Expertise
Strong functional knowledge of TRM areas such as:
oFinancial instruments lifecycle
oValuations, accruals, postings
oMarket data handling
oCredit market risk
oHedge accounting
Experience integrating TRM with FI, CO, BCM, IHC, and external banking/market data systems.
AI Ready Skills
Hands on use of AI copilots, LLM based documentation tools, and AI supported test automation.
Ability to integrate pre built AI features (not advanced AI model development) into treasury workflows.
Awareness of AI tool limitations and responsible AI usage in finance and risk domains.
General Skills
Strong analytical skills around treasury processes, financial instruments, and risk scenarios.
Ability to convert business requirements into scalable SAP TRM configurations.
Effective communication with treasury and finance stakeholders.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted tools.

Good to Have
SAP Certification in Treasury and Risk Management.
Exposure to market data platforms (e.g., Bloomberg, Refinitiv) or integration middleware (CPI / SWIFT).
Experience with automation of valuations, reconciliations, and treasury reporting.
Familiarity with cloud based cash forecasting or analytics tools.

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more accurate TRM solutions using AI assisted productivity accelerators.
Enhance transparency, compliance, and efficiency in treasury operations.
Support finance transformation by bridging business teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native teams where needed.

  • Translate customer requirements into deployable solutions. Work directly with customer technical stakeholders alongside Aivars SA and DM to scope, size, and iterate use cases against measurable outcomes - success rate, latency, adoption.
  • Report and govern delivery. Contribute to sprint tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder governance for the use cases you own.
What Youll Bring

  • Experience with multi-speaker diarization and conversation segmentation.
  • Production fluency in Python plus at least one of Node.js, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Practical use of AI/ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) and conversational AI design - prompt engineering and integration with LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Bedrock models).
  • Cloud deployment experience on AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, EKS, Polly, Transcribe, Bedrock) with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under SOW/contract constraints - scoping, prioritizing, and shipping within a defined timeline and budget across live customer engagements.
  • Comfort working across multiple concurrent customer engagements with differing requirements, tech stacks, and stakeholders.
Preferred Experience

  • Exposure to regulated industries (fintech, healthcare, BFSI) and their compliance and security constraints.
  • Experience with enterprise stakeholder management - running status calls, translating technical tradeoffs into business language.
  • Familiarity with low-code voice platforms alongside custom infrastructure.
  • Voice analytics, transcription tooling, and Indian-language STT/TTS models.
  • AWS or speech technology certifications.

Why This Role, Why Aivar

  • Work that ships to real customers. Every use case you build runs live on enterprise calls, measured by customer outcomes, not demos.

AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead


Job Type: Full-Time
Position: AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead
Industry: Education & Technology
Contract: Temporary/ Contractual


About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, highly motivated and forward-thinking AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead to take ownership of the research, development, implementation and integration of Artificial Intelligence across our organisation.

This is not simply an IT support or ChatGPT-based role. We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about AI, automation and emerging technology and wants to become deeply involved in helping us build an AI-enabled organisation.

You will work closely with senior management, learn how different areas of the company operate, identify opportunities for improvement and develop practical AI and automation solutions that improve efficiency, education, administration, marketing, customer experience and overall business performance.


The role combines AI research, development, automation, integration, dashboard creation, data visualisation, experimentation, implementation, training and strategic thinking.


Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

  • Researching new and emerging AI technologies, platforms and models.
  • Identifying opportunities to use AI and automation throughout the organisation.
  • Developing and implementing AI-powered workflows and business processes.
  • Automating repetitive and time-consuming administrative tasks.
  • Integrating AI with existing company software, websites, databases and platforms.
  • Building AI assistants, copilots, agents and agentic workflows.
  • Developing autonomous and semi-autonomous AI processes with appropriate human oversight.
  • Developing API, webhook and third-party software integrations.
  • Exploring Model Context Protocol (MCP) and emerging AI interoperability standards.
  • Developing internal AI tools, applications and dashboards.
  • Designing and building professional, interactive dashboards for management and different areas of the organisation.
  • Creating real-time and automated dashboards that bring together information from multiple systems and data sources.
  • Developing KPI, student-performance, operational, financial, marketing, CRM, sales and management dashboards.
  • Using AI within dashboards to analyse data, identify trends, highlight risks and opportunities, and generate actionable insights.
  • Developing AI-powered reporting and natural-language analytics, allowing authorised users to ask questions about company data and receive reports, summaries, charts and insights.
  • Exploring AI-assisted software development and coding agents.
  • Developing AI-powered knowledge bases and internal search systems.
  • Implementing RAG, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases and knowledge-management solutions.
  • Exploring AI-powered document processing and information extraction.
  • Developing AI-assisted data analysis, reporting and business intelligence.
  • Exploring predictive analytics and decision-support systems.
  • Supporting AI integration within CRM, customer service, admissions and communication systems.
  • Developing marketing, content and social-media automations.
  • Exploring AI-powered voice, telephone and conversational systems.
  • Exploring AI-generated images, audio, video, avatars and multimedia.
  • Investigating computer-use agents capable of interacting with browsers and software.
  • Exploring multimodal AI capable of understanding text, images, documents, audio and video.
  • Evaluating open-source, cloud-based, local and private AI models.
  • Exploring model customisation, fine-tuning and domain-specific AI where appropriate.
  • Monitoring the accuracy, reliability and performance of AI systems.
  • Developing AI evaluation and quality-assurance processes.
  • Maintaining appropriate human review for important AI-generated outputs.
  • Evaluating AI costs, subscriptions, API usage and return on investment.
  • Supporting AI security, privacy, GDPR, safeguarding and governance requirements.
  • Training staff in the effective and responsible use of AI.
  • Creating internal AI procedures, documentation and best-practice guidelines.
  • Monitoring developments within the global AI industry and recommending technologies the organisation should investigate.
  • Developing and maintaining a longer-term AI Transformation Roadmap for the organisation.

You are not expected to be an expert in every area.

What matters is your ability to learn rapidly, investigate unfamiliar technologies, experiment intelligently and turn promising ideas into practical solutions.


AI in Education

As an education organisation, a major part of our AI strategy will involve exploring how technology can improve teaching and learning.


Projects may include:

  • AI tutoring systems
  • Personalised and adaptive learning
  • Intelligent question generation
  • Assessment creation
  • AI-assisted marking
  • Automated feedback
  • Student performance analysis
  • Student progress and performance dashboards

  • Student progress reporting

Accuracy and safeguarding are extremely important. AI-generated educational content must therefore be properly tested, reviewed and quality controlled.



We do not want somebody who is dependent upon one particular AI provider.


The successful candidate should be able to compare technologies and select the most appropriate solution for each business requirement.

The Person We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in somebody who is:

  • Passionate about AI and emerging technology.
  • Extremely curious and willing to learn.
  • Self-motivated.
  • Technically confident.
  • Innovative and creative.
  • Highly organised.
  • Analytical.
  • Commercially aware.
  • An excellent problem-solver.
  • Comfortable experimenting with unfamiliar technology.
  • Able to research independently.
  • Able to work collaboratively.
  • Comfortable taking ownership of projects.
  • Able to communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Able to turn complex data into clear, useful dashboards and management information.
  • Prepared to challenge inefficient processes.
  • Persistent when solving difficult problems.
  • Focused on practical outcomes rather than technology for technology's sake.
  • Excited by the rapid development of AI.

Most importantly, you must genuinely enjoy learning.

AI is developing too quickly for anyone to rely solely on what they already know.

Take Ownership

We are not looking for somebody who simply waits to be given individual tasks.

We want somebody whose approach is:

Explore Identify Research Design Build Test Validate Implement Measure Improve

You should be willing to examine an existing process and ask:

"Is there a better way of doing this, and can AI or automation help us achieve it?"

You will be encouraged to research technologies, propose ideas, build prototypes, test solutions and take successful projects through to implementation.

Full-Time Commitment

This is a full-time role requiring significant commitment and engagement with the organisation during and alongside our normal company operating hours.

We are looking for someone who wants to become an integral and long-term part of the organisation rather than simply providing occasional AI consultancy.

The successful candidate will be expected to continually learn and develop as AI technology evolves.


Learning & Career Development

This position offers significant scope for professional development.

You will have opportunities to:

  • Research emerging AI technologies.
  • Experiment with new platforms.
  • Develop real-world AI solutions.
  • Build AI agents and automated systems.
  • Design and develop business intelligence and management dashboards.
  • Work directly with senior management.
  • Gain experience across multiple business functions.
  • Develop AI strategies and implementation plans.
  • Lead significant AI projects.
  • Train and support colleagues.
  • Develop specialist technical expertise.
  • Build a substantial portfolio of practical AI implementations.
  • Progress as the organisation's AI capabilities expand.

For the right individual, the position has the potential to develop into a senior role with responsibility for the organisation's wider AI strategy, automation, business intelligence and digital transformation.


What Success Looks Like

Initially, you will learn how our organisation operates and identify opportunities where AI and automation can make an immediate difference.


You will then help develop an AI Transformation Roadmap, covering:

  • Immediate opportunities and quick wins
  • Automation opportunities
  • Medium-term AI projects
  • Strategic AI initiatives
  • Educational AI development
  • System integrations
  • Management dashboards and business intelligence
  • Centralised data and reporting
  • Productivity improvements
  • Cost-saving opportunities
  • New products and services
  • Security and governance
  • Future technology requirements

Projects should be assessed according to:

Business Impact Feasibility Cost Risk Scalability

Ultimately, your work should help us:

Reduce Administration Increase Productivity Improve Quality Personalise Learning Improve Customer Experience Improve Decision-Making Improve Data Visibility Reduce Costs Develop New Capabilities Create New Opportunities


How to Apply

Please submit your CV and covering letter explaining:

  1. Your practical experience with AI and automation.
  2. Which AI platforms, models and technologies you have worked with.
  3. Examples of AI systems, agents, automations or applications you have personally developed.
  4. Your experience with APIs and software integrations.
  5. Your coding/programming experience.
  6. Your experience creating dashboards, business intelligence systems or data visualisations, including the platforms you have used.
  7. An example of a business process you have automated or significantly improved.
  8. Which area of AI currently interests you most and why.
  9. What AI technologies you are currently learning.
  10. Where you believe AI is heading over the next 35 years.
  11. How you believe AI could transform a growing education organisation.
  12. What you would investigate during your first 30 days in this position.
  13. Links to any relevant GitHub repositories, portfolios, dashboards, demonstrations, applications or projects you have developed.

Please also answer the following question:

"If you were given responsibility for transforming our organisation through AI, what are the first three areas you would investigate, and why?"

We are looking for someone who doesn't just want a job in AI. We want someone who wants to continuously learn, build, experiment and ultimately help us create an AI-enabled organisation.

If you are ambitious, technically curious and excited about where Artificial Intelligence is heading, we would love to hear from you.
